description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs a series of tests for a Git post-index-change hook. It defines several test cases that verify the behavior of the hook during different Git operations like commit, checkout, reset, and update-index, by executing the hook and checking expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies success.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Runs the post-index-change hook with specified arguments.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
